name: adapt_reverted_fix_ruby_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, calc.rb rewritten back to the buggy version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix
prompts: calc.rb has a bug in add(a, b) - it currently subtracts instead of adding. Fix it so add(a, b) returns a + b.
Your fix to calc.rb seems to have been reverted - the subtraction bug is back. Please reapply the fix so add(a, b) correctly returns a + b.

disruptions.description: calc.rb reverted back to the buggy (subtraction) version

test_setup_files.calc_hidden_test.rb:
require_relative "calc"

raise "add(3,4) = #{add(3, 4)}" unless add(3, 4) == 7
raise "add(-1,1) = #{add(-1, 1)}" unless add(-1, 1) == 0
puts "all tests passed"
